1011-2728-4153-5147.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-4153-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-4153-5147.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-3499-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

When Anikthea enters the battlefield, it and Life Finds a Way trigger.
Resolve the Anikthea trigger, choosing not to exile anything.
Resolve the Life Finds a Way trigger, creating two token copies of the Oblivion Ring token.
Repeat from step 4.
